Not based on actual tarot cards.... I had to give 2 stars because this is misnamed. Should just be called “psychic cards” or “future cards”. The cards aren’t actually based on real tarot cards and their meanings. It is nice that it’s a Christian set of cards, as opposed to pagan, but making them Christian doesn’t mean completely change them and make up your own deck of cards. The artwork is nice, only reason doesn’t get 1 star.
